result:
Good, server stopped cleanly. Here's a summary of what I found and fixed.

## What was wrong

This SaaS pivoted from "InboxZap" (email cleanup) to "Lumina" (AI meeting assistant). The rebrand covered the homepage/features/pricing, but left real damage behind:

- **`/blog` was fully broken** — a client component fetching `/api/posts`, which doesn't exist, so the post list never rendered for users *or* crawlers (no real links = no internal linking into posts).
- **`sitemap.ts` never listed a single blog post** (an explicit `TODO` admitted it).
- **`/faq` 404'd sitewide** — linked in the header and footer of every page, redirected by `next.config.js` to `/#faq`, an anchor that didn't exist anywhere.
- **`app/layout.tsx` still shipped the old InboxZap `<title>`/description/OG tags** — would have regressed branding across the whole site.
- **`/features` and `/pricing` were linked from nav but didn't exist in the source** — 404 waiting to happen.
- All 12 existing blog posts were 100% leftover email-cleanup content (bulk-delete emails, Gmail filters, inbox zero), getting thousands of impressions but ranking at position 42–58 with near-zero clicks — consistent with being orphaned from internal links/sitemap, and even if they ranked well, irrelevant to a meeting-assistant buyer.

## What I changed

- Rewrote `app/layout.tsx` with correct Lumina metadata + title template.
- Added `app/features/page.tsx` and `app/pricing/page.tsx`.
- Rebuilt `/blog` as a real server component with crawlable `<a>` links, and added `app/blog/[slug]/page.tsx` with per-post metadata + `BlogPosting` JSON-LD.
- Fixed `app/sitemap.ts` to include features, pricing, and every post.
- Added a real FAQ section (`id="faq"`) to the homepage with `FAQPage` + `Organization` + `SoftwareApplication` JSON-LD, so the existing redirect finally points somewhere real.
- Content triage for the 12 legacy posts: 4 with a genuine topical bridge (overload, comparisons, automation) got rewritten into Lumina-relevant posts at new, descriptive URLs with 301s from the old slugs; the remaining 8 with no plausible bridge (Gmail storage, Outlook cleanup, mass-unsubscribe, bulk-delete, etc.) 301 to `/blog`. Added 2 new posts targeting real Lumina demand (meeting notes template, action-item tracking).

Verified with an actual `npm install` + `next build` + `next start` — build is clean, all 6 posts statically generate, redirects return 308 to the right destinations, sitemap lists everything, and the FAQ anchor is now real.
